quotes.author: Kate D
quotes.text: Unforgetable experience!!! The captain Ryan took us right to the manatees. We got in the water with ease and floated around. The manatees swooped right under us. There were three... big dad, mom and little baby. They weren't afraid of us and fed under us and circled around us. We floated without any movement and the manatees brushed up against me a few times. Oh how I wish I could have touched one, but we respected their environment and let them come to us. Melanie got some great photos too!

quotes.author: Deborah W
quotes.text: Wonderful manatee snokeling! Everything was great! Captain Ron made every effort to make sure we were happy, safe, and had the best possible time. Malayna our guide clearly loved the manatees and the entire area around King's Bay and Crystal River. We loved that she did photos and videos so we could just enjoy the manatees and the wonderful adventure snorkeling with them. 5 stars and we would go with them again!

quotes.author: Gillian D
quotes.text: Amazing experience We are currently on holiday as a family of 3 from Scotland, we had the most incredible day today swimming with the manatee, absolutely beautiful docile creatures. This has to be one of the best experiences we have had. Our 10yr has been buzzing all day and has already said he is 100% doing this again next year! Big thanks to the captain and gabby who took us out and looked after us.

quotes.author: Rhubba286
quotes.text: A must do! Awesome experience! Absolutely loved Malayna and Captain Ron! Would highly recommend, however, I do think I would prefer a private outing if we come back. I’ve figured out I’m not a people person when I’m not at work 😂🤣😂 However, there was only 2 other couples on this experience. Definitely worth the money!

quotes.author: Julie T
quotes.text: Five star excursion Can't recommend this charter enough. We had a great time. Captain Ron and crew were brilliant and made sure we had a great experience with the manatees and provided great pictures and videos for us. Would definitely recommend.

quotes.author: William A
quotes.text: Great Experience Great experience. Everyone was polite, friendly, and easy to talk to. Having a smaller tour gave us plenty of time to look around. If you've never tried a tour like this, I highly recommend this organization.
